description: Use this when the user wants a fair random pick of winners from a group: a giveaway, door prize, raffle without tickets, classroom or team pick. Publishes a draw page with a public link where entrants add their names (or only the organizer adds them), and returns a private organizer link. Optionally adds a first list of names. Up to 500 entries, 1 to 20 winners, up to 10 backups. For free draws only: set free_entry to true to confirm nobody pays to enter; it does not handle money. Does not draw yet; use draw_winners for that.

backups.description: Number of backup winners drawn in order after the winners, 0 to 10 (default 0). Example: 2.

free_entry.description: Set true to confirm nobody pays to enter and no money is pooled; this tool does not handle money.

names.description: Entrant display names, up to 500, each up to 40 characters, one person per item, e.g. ["Ana", "Ben K.", "Chloe"]. First names or nicknames only.

note.description: Optional short note shown on the page, up to 400 characters, e.g. Draw on Friday at the team call.

prize.description: What the winners get, up to 200 characters, e.g. One 50-minute massage voucher.

public_entry.description: true (default) = people add their own name on the public page; false = only the organizer adds names.

title.description: Short title of the draw, up to 120 characters, e.g. Team lunch voucher draw.

name: create_prize_draw
title: Create prize draw
